description: Read one full text by id from fr_legifrance_search's results: a JORFTEXT (Journal officiel), KALITEXT/KALIARTI/KALICONT (collective agreement text/article/container), CETATEXT (Conseil d'État decision), CONSTEXT (Constitutional Council decision), CNILTEXT or ACCOTEXT id. For a circulaire (which has no prefixed id, just a number), pass fond:"CIRC". Refuses a JURITEXT id (Cour de cassation) and a LEGITEXT/LEGIARTI id (codes/LODA), naming the sibling pack that serves those.

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product); Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

fond.description: Only needed to read a circulaire by its bare numeric id, which has no recognisable prefix.

id.description: The text id, from a fr_legifrance_search result, or a bare circulaire number.

name: fr_legifrance_text
title: Fr Legifrance Text
